actualQuestion: Did weather cause all of the operational abnormalities?
expected: 说明只能观察到关联线索

review.logic: Correctly rejects blanket weather causation and separates medium current risk from historical anomalies and business scale.
review.evidence: All displayed monthly figures/windows/peer count and annual scale are supported; missing-weather flag honored. 45.77 million is the correct conversion of 4577 ten-thousand passenger movements.
review.unsupportedClaims: No invented operational fact or service commitment. Threshold wording says more than five as the rule, whereas implementation includes exactly five. Displayed anomaly classification is unaffected.
review.proposedFacts: Four explicitly unverified, unapplied information-gathering proposals.
notes: Describe the threshold as five percentage points or more below baseline.
